lead.headline: Institutional Consortium Challenges Stablecoin Hegemony
lead.tldr: The entry of a 140-company consortium including Visa and BlackRock signals a shift from native crypto stablecoins toward institutional-grade, compliant payment rails.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief examines the accelerating convergence of TradFi infrastructure and on-chain settlement layers.

top_signals.title: Stripe, Visa and over 140 other businesses to launch stablecoin to rival Tether and Circle
top_signals.summary: A massive consortium of over 140 businesses, including Stripe, Visa, BlackRock, and Google, is launching a new stablecoin. This initiative aims to create a direct competitor to the current market leaders, Tether and Circle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A coordinated effort by Stripe, Visa, and BlackRock threatens the market share of Tether and Circle by integrating stablecoins directly into global merchant networks.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq brings proprietary market data onchain through Pyth8m
top_signals.summary: Nasdaq has integrated its proprietary market data onto the blockchain via Pyth Network's Pyth8m service. This move bridges traditional financial market data with Web3 infrastructure, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of on-chain price feeds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nasdaq's move to put proprietary data on-chain via Pyth8m reduces oracle latency and increases the institutional utility of DeFi primitives.

top_signals.title: UK sets capital, market abuse rules in landmark crypto framework
top_signals.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has finalized a landmark regulatory framework for crypto assets, focusing on capital requirements, stablecoins, and market abuse. These rules are set for implementation by October 2027, providing a clear legal roadmap for the industry in the UK.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The FCA's 2027 roadmap provides the long-term regulatory certainty required for institutional capital to deploy in the UK market.

top_signals.title: World Cup tickets and crypto sales: five things we learnt from Donald Trump’s financial disclosure
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump's financial disclosures reveal significant earnings exceeding $1 billion from digital currency interests, real estate, and stock trades. The report highlights the intersection of high-profile political figures and the crypto market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: High-profile political alignment with digital assets continues to drive retail sentiment and mainstream legitimacy.

top_signals.title: UK crypto investors sue Binance, Changpeng Zhao for $200M28m, UK crypto investors sue Binance, Changpeng Zhao for $200MOne Binance customer said he lost the equivalent of more than $132,000 from the crypto exchange’s derivatives offerings before restrictions were imposed on Binance.
top_signals.summary: UK-based cryptocurrency investors have filed a lawsuit against Binance and its founder, Changpeng Zhao, seeking $200 million in damages. The lawsuit alleges losses stemming from the exchange's derivatives offerings prior to the implementation of UK regulatory restrictions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $200M lawsuit against Binance underscores the lingering legal liabilities for exchanges that operated derivatives in restricted jurisdictions.

on_the_radar.title: SEC opens ETF rule review following crypto fund surge, prediction markets push
on_the_radar.summary: The SEC has initiated a rule review regarding the regulation of a new class of ETFs linked to prediction markets. This move follows a surge in crypto-related funds and the growing popularity of prediction market instruments.

on_the_radar.title: MetaMask unveils all-in-one Money Account offerings users up to 4% APY on mUSD holdings
on_the_radar.summary: MetaMask has launched a new 'Money Account' feature that offers users up to 4% APY on mUSD holdings. The service utilizes Monad as its primary chain and leverages Morpho vaults to generate yield for users.

on_the_radar.title: New York Life makes first tokenized move partnering with Centrifuge on high-yield corporate bond strategy
on_the_radar.summary: New York Life is partnering with Centrifuge to launch its first tokenized fund, bringing a high-yield corporate bond strategy to the blockchain. This move allows eligible investors to access institutional-grade investment strategies via tokenization.

on_the_radar.title: Solana Company Signs MOU with Kazakhstan’s Alatau City
on_the_radar.summary: Solana Company has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to develop the blockchain infrastructure for Alatau City in Kazakhstan. This digital-first megacity project is supported by over $6 billion in potential investment.

on_the_radar.title: ESMA MiCA warning puts Binance EU service changes under scrutiny32m, ESMA MiCA warning puts Binance EU service changes under scrutinyESMA said EU crypto clients must be served through a MiCA-authorized entity as Binance faces questions over its servicing model in the region after the MiCA deadline.
on_the_radar.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has issued a warning regarding the MiCA framework, emphasizing that crypto clients in the EU must be served by authorized entities. This puts Binance's current servicing model and operational changes in the region under regulatory scrutiny.

on_the_radar.title: Self-exiled Chinese billionaire sentenced to 30 years for fraud involving crypto
on_the_radar.summary: A self-exiled Chinese billionaire has been sentenced to 30 years in prison for his role in a massive fraud conspiracy. The scheme involved the misappropriation of over $1 billion using cryptocurrency.

on_the_radar.title: Securitize to debut on NYSE this Thursday after gaining final nod for merger
on_the_radar.summary: Securitize is set to debut on the New York Stock Exchange this Thursday following shareholder approval for its merger with Cantor. The business combination is expected to officially close on Wednesday.

on_the_radar.title: UK regulator waters down landmark crypto rules
on_the_radar.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) is easing capital and disclosure requirements for its upcoming digital assets regime. This move follows industry complaints that the initial landmark rules were too onerous for firms to implement.

linkedin_post:
The stablecoin landscape is shifting. While Tether and Circle built the foundation, a new consortium of 140+ giants—including Visa, Stripe, and BlackRock—is moving to institutionalize the sector. This isn't just about another token; it's about the integration of programmable money into the world's most powerful payment rails. 

Simultaneously, we see Nasdaq bringing proprietary data on-chain and the UK finalizing a comprehensive regulatory framework. The 'wild west' era is being replaced by a sophisticated, compliant infrastructure layer designed for global scale. For founders, the opportunity is shifting from building basic primitives to creating high-value services atop this institutional plumbing.

Is the era of the 'native' stablecoin ending, or will the incumbents' first-mover advantage hold?
